name: Lumidouce Elegy
effectTemplate: ATK increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color>. After the equipping character triggers Burning on an opponent or deals Dendro DMG to Burning opponents, the DMG dealt is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color>.
